projects.name: Muskogee, Oklahoma campus 1.5 GW expansion
projects.quote: Expanded the Company’s total gross power capacity pipeline to 4.5 GW, including planned 1.5 GW expansions at each of the Company’s Muskogee, Oklahoma and Pecos, Texas campuses.

projects.name: Hunt County, Texas land and power acquisition
projects.quote: Closed on the acquisiton of land and power in Hunt County, Texas for approximately $233 million, which is expected to support ~430 MW of gross power capacity, with an approved ERCOT interconnection ramp schedule.

projects.name: Polaris DS LLC acquisition
projects.quote: The Polaris DS LLC transaction, subject to customary regulatory approvals and closing conditions, is expected to close in the third quarter of 2026.
